body:
Fixes a bug where the restart clock would show t = 0 when restarting a simulation in a REPL session with `config_dict["restart_t"] = <checkpoint_time>`. The fix is to add an `Input.update_t_start_from_restarts!(config_dict)` instruction inside the simulation build step, so simulations triggered from REPL sessions show the correct clock time. 

Builds on #2197 

Co-author: @ph-kev
title: Fix land restarts, fix clock update upon sim restart, update to ClimaDiagnostics0.4
